prompts:
Refine the attached KAIRO identity references into ONE spectacular professional landscape 16:10 applied-brand presentation. Image1 is the ACTUAL VECTOR PROOF: it defines the exact C-led KAIRO serif wordmark, the A-derived two architectural planes/negative-space passage mark, and the palette. Image2 is the previously selected C / HUMANIST MOODBOARD: use its warmth, tactile dimensional print, atmosphere and mature editorial restraint. Do not retain Image1's proof-sheet layout or technical labels. Do not invent a new symbol. Stay faithful to the wordmark and symbol contours in Image1 and consistent across all mockups.

USER SELECTION: C is the primary identity, with A's distinct spatial icon in support. The KAIRO serif wordmark should feel timeless, intelligent, hospitable, refined, rooted in learning but not a traditional school crest. Strong moderate contrast serif, beautiful K/A/R, close to actual proof. No sans wordmark, no added crest or shield. Do not force the icon beside every wordmark: use wordmark alone on elegant stationery, icon alone on shirt and app, paired lockup for a poster. The abstraction signifies a passage opening from knowledge to action.

COMPOSITION: eight premium art-directed panels, large calm hero at top left with KAIRO serif on warm parchment and a small side view of the symbol in matte raised forest-green material (3D effect is a physical finish only, flat identity still clear). Small heading "KAIRO / REFINED". Palette strip with exact minimal labels "Parchment", "Forest", "Olive", "Sand", "Ochre" matching #F3ECDD #1E332A #626B4D #CEBEA3 #B39356. Rich forest panel for ivory inverse primary wordmark.
APPLIED PANELS: 
1) portrait-cropped beautiful tailored OLIVE teacher shirt and separate CREAM and CHARCOAL shirts together, small consistent LEFT-CHEST icon embroidery in cream on olive/charcoal and forest on cream; enough detail to judge thread scale; no large logo patches or giant brand across torso.
2) tactile warm uncoated paper letterhead, an embossed deep-forest document folder and a cream study notebook. Use generous asymmetric serif wordmark layout with thin subtle enlarged architectural CONTOUR/PASSAGE lines cropped off edges across the book covers. The graphic should derive from the mark's open stepped negative-space path, not be random doodles or an extra logo. Forest ink, warm sand, quiet deboss detail.
3) luxurious business card pair, forest with ivory wordmark and cream with forest mark, one elegant embossed closeup to show the 3D depth the user likes, but readable printed logo still present.
4) campus poster in warm modern architecture, purposeful large serif KAIRO and the paired symbol, minimal exact line "Learn. Prove. Act."
5) sophisticated app icon with flat spatial symbol, and a cream mobile lesson header showing small serif KAIRO. Product still looks like useful learning technology, not a perfume label.
6) understated exact one-colour black/white flat-logo proof inset showing symbol and wordmark work without dimensional finish.
Natural cinematic morning light, warm ivory stone, deep green, olive fabrics, cotton paper, restrained gold accent. Outstanding photoreal materials, emboss depths, shadows and art direction. Highly legible main lettering, sparse text, disciplined gutters, no generic graphic-design template, no gratuitous plants, no random visual clutter, no gradients, no AI stars, no book pictogram, no watermarks or manufacturer names. This is a coherent C-led evolution with the supplied A-style mark, not a fourth unrelated logo.

Create a refined photorealistic KAIRO brand application triptych, landscape16:10, from the attached actual vector identity proof (Image1) and warm C-style selected brand moodboard (Image2). This is the second detail plate for the SAME identity, not a new logo. Use exact reference KAIRO serif letterforms and the A-derived architectural passage icon. Preserve all actual logo geometry as closely as possible, no new symbols, no alternate wordmarks. Let the user judge real material behaviour and subtle dimensional finish.

Three beautifully lit editorial still-life panels separated by thin warm ivory gutters:
LEFT 36% width: close view of two premium A4 notebooks/reports on pale travertine; one deep forest cover with ivory serif "KAIRO" top aligned, one parchment cover with dark green "KAIRO". Carefully designed ABSTRACT oversized passage/architectural line graphic runs across their covers and is cropped off edges; quiet olive tone-on-tone in one, sand deboss lines in the other. Add one creamy letterhead sheet with small KAIRO header partially beneath. Very tactile cotton fibres and accurately controlled blind-deboss depth. The brand's serif type and abstract graphics are the star, books look genuinely professionally designed, no fake body copy.
CENTRE 32% width: three deliberately arranged tailored button shirts in OLIVE, WARM IVORY and CHARCOAL, rolled/folded tastefully so each LEFT-CHEST logo is visible. Small accurate spatial icon, not oversized. Cream thread on olive and charcoal, deep forest on ivory. Macro detail: stitches, fabric weave, slight natural cloth undulation, crisp edges; never a metallic hard pin or giant badge. No face/body needed.
RIGHT32% width: dark-forest luxury business card on warm ivory card, slight dimensional raised/deboss wordmark "KAIRO", flat black/ivory mini logo proof discreetly nearby and a beautiful small brushed brass/acrylic desk sign using the same symbol; tactile side-light and natural shadows, no gold glare hiding the logo. Minimal labels along bottom only "Paper", "Cloth", "Detail", and a tiny top title "KAIRO / MATERIAL STUDY". Nothing else.

Palette must remain parchment#F3ECDD, forest#1E332A, olive#626B4D, sand#CEBEA3, ochre#B39356. High-end contemporary education/technology brand, calm luxury not ostentatious, warm cinematic classroom atmosphere. Restrained layout, no gradients/neon/sparkles/crowns/shields/clipart; no random people or text. Make clean useful branding look materially convincing. Real finish samples are still future work, this is design visualization.
